name: Stage 37:2: Kärrgruvorna to Koppartorp
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 37:2, Kärrgruvorna to Koppartorp.
utilities: Kärrgruvorna has parking, shelter, fireplace, toilet, and the Kärrgruvan spring at the branch start. Start-side buses are available from Skräddarstugan, Laggarbo, or Syrtorpsvägen, but timetables and service days need checking.

Koppartorp/Tunabergs kyrka is the practical endpoint, with weekday-limited bus access, toilet, seasonal/field-check water, heritage/museum/cafe context, and connections to stages 41 and 42 plus Gruvslingan.
Nyköping C is the nearest practical train anchor but is far from both ends; use bus, taxi, bike, or pickup for trail access.
waterSources: Kärrgruvan spring near the start and Koppartorp tap near the end are the only verified practical water points. Treat/filter spring water, do not assume tested drinking-water quality, and verify seasonal tap availability.
No reliable mid-stage potable water was found. Natural water and old dam/mining water should not be treated as a safe refill.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden distance is 8 km and the 2025 long-distance passport lists 7.5 km, while Naturkartan exposes 6776 m / about 6.9 km, the current local route line measures about 6.83 km, and OSM relation 9631218 measures about 7.23 km. Keep the official 8 km and note that the drawn line is shorter and currently uncertain because of the active reroute.

Current official issue as of the 2026-04-27 research pass: a 2025-10-25 warning for spruce bark-beetle damage has escalated, with maintainers reporting that they no longer dare clear more fallen/falling spruce and that the stage will be temporarily shortened quite substantially. Follow current orange markings, ribbons and signs; older GPX/Naturkartan/AllTrails/local geometry may not match the safe signed route.

Topology: this is the second half of the inland Nävekvarn-Kärrgruvorna-Koppartorp branch, connecting from stage 37:1 at Kärrgruvorna to the Koppartorp hub where stages 41 and 42 also connect. Snap route-builder topology to OSM node 5486317989 at Kärrgruvorna and OSM node 2889617483 at Koppartorp.
Related local options: Kärrgruvan runt at the start, Gruvslingan at Koppartorp, Tunabergsrundan, and nearby Simonberget/Koppartorp/Kummelbergsrundan local walks.

Route character: officially easy/green in normal conditions but culturally dense and stop-start, with mine holes, smelting sites, dam/waterworks remains, rock carvings, Tomtabäcken, and Koppartorp's mining village and church. Older reports describe repeated small ups/downs around mine features; treat pre-2026 reports as condition-stale for routing.

Hazards: many old mine holes and ruins, fenced/open/water-filled shafts, cultural remains that should not be disturbed, a steeper climb after the Koppartorpsristningen/road crossing toward the stoll, some road crossings around Tomta/Koppartorp, and the active bark-beetle temporary reroute. Stay on marked paths, supervise children/dogs, and be extra careful around mine edges in snow, leaves or low light.

Camping: Kärrgruvan shelter at the start is the strongest overnight infrastructure. No dedicated tent site was found on stage 37:2 itself; use allemansrätten carefully and avoid mine holes, ruins, homes, roads, fields, and sensitive cultural sites.

Fire: use only prepared fireplaces at Kärrgruvan and Koppartorp/Storgruvan, check current fire bans, and extinguish fully. Kärrgruvan has known previous fire history nearby, and firewood is not guaranteed.

If extending into Simonberget reserve, tenting is only allowed below Simonberget between the dry toilet and fireplace for up to two nights; fires are only allowed at marked prepared sites; dogs must be leashed; Kummelberget bird-protection area is closed February 1-August 15.

Koppartorp is not a reliable resupply point. The hembygdsgård cafe/museum is seasonal and year-specific; the Koppartorp tap/toilet are useful but service-dependent rather than guaranteed public 24/7 infrastructure; the only dependable grocery context for the larger branch is back in Nävekvarn.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvorna / stage 37:2 start
facilities.description: OSM topology start shared with stage 37:1. Official Kärrgruvan/Kärrgruvan runt start is nearby at 58.646950,16.858067 and works as practical access context.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvan / Blombergstorp parking
facilities.description: Small parking near Kärrgruvorna and Kärrgruvan runt access; Naturkartan context indicates about 3-5 cars, so verify capacity.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvan shelter
facilities.description: Shelter at the stage start; first-come/shared and close to the official coordinate. No booking, no bins, and no guaranteed firewood.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvan fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared firepit by the shelter. Strong fire-safety warning: check fire bans and extinguish completely because previous fire history is noted nearby.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvan secondary fireplace
facilities.description: Additional mapped firepit/rest point in the Kärrgruvan shelter cluster; verify field condition and fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvan picnic table
facilities.description: Mapped picnic table by the shelter/fireplace cluster at the stage start.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvan dry toilet
facilities.description: Mapped dry toilet near the shelter and mine area; Kärrgruvan runt confirms ordinary and accessible dry toilets, but field condition can vary.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvan spring/well
facilities.description: Mapped well/water point and nearby official source context. Treat/filter/boil because Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvorna mine area
facilities.description: Historic mine area with 40+ mine workings over a broad area, including ruins, open/fenced shafts and water-filled holes; stay on marked paths, control children and dogs, and avoid shaft edges in snow/leaves/low light.

facilities.name: Kärrgruvorna northern information board
facilities.description: Information board in the Kärrgruvorna mining field; interpretation point, not a staffed service.

facilities.name: Stage 37:2 temporary reroute warning
facilities.description: Official warnings from 2025-10-25 and 2026-04-27: severe spruce bark-beetle damage, trees fallen and still falling, and the stage will be temporarily shortened/rerouted substantially. Follow current orange markings, ribbons and signs; no machine-readable reroute geometry is published.

facilities.name: Stage 37:2 geometry uncertainty
facilities.description: Mapped sources show about 6.8-7.2 km while official planning remains 8 km. During the active bark-beetle reroute, do not treat OSM, Naturkartan, AllTrails, or the local GPX line as definitive routing.

facilities.name: Koppartorp tap

facilities.name: Tunabergs hembygdsgård / summer cafe
facilities.description: Museum/cafe and heritage area in Koppartorp; seasonal and year-specific. Nyköpingsguiden has listed July 1-Aug 11 summer cafe/museum periods, but verify the current season.

facilities.name: Tunabergs kyrka
facilities.description: Södermanland's only wooden church, built in 1620 per church and county sources.

facilities.name: Storgruvan / Koppartorp
facilities.description: Historic major mine at Koppartorp, with information boards, fenced/open mine context and mining landscape. Do not enter shafts or fenced areas.

facilities.name: Storgruvan / Koppartorp fireplace
facilities.description: Grill/rest place near Tunabergs hembygdsgård and Storgruvan; exact firepoint should be field-verified and fire-ban status checked.

facilities.name: Simonberget reserve dry toilet
facilities.description: Off-stage Simonberget reserve facility near Koppartorp options; relevant only if extending to Simonberget/Kummelbergsrundan.
